status: Implementation analysis captured before final Issue547 peer review and merge; user acceptance remains pending.
scope: Evidence-backed improvement candidates; no SF implementation changes authorized or performed here.

items.observed: The full tracked repository was 47,603,453 bytes; the SF base archive limit is 32 MB. This was detected before launch, not an executed failure.
items.proposed: Preflight archive/source bytes and explicit exclusions; retain target commit and per-file hashes for filtered snapshots.
items.implemented_in_this_task: Private snapshot builders retain source hashes and exclusions. The parent verifies the full real checkout; SF itself is unchanged.

items.observed: Run 632c7346 completed its worker and protected contract check, then the parent-supplied python -I unittest command could not import Tools.
items.proposed: Validate verifier cwd/import/dependency assumptions before expensive execution; retain command failure attribution separately from candidate defects.
items.implemented_in_this_task: Corrected the verifier and submitted run 9c048ee5; retained the original failed run.

items.observed: Initial analysis run cf98e9fa timed out after 899.93 seconds with cleanup confirmed. It was not accepted.
items.proposed: Task-size-appropriate budget and bounded discovery deliverables before implementation; report timeout as incomplete.
items.implemented_in_this_task: Later tasks used an explicit 3,600-second budget and fixed source, contract and verification commands.

items.observed: The complete Swift package needs pinned external sources and Rust archives beyond the source snapshot limit. Cache permissions and native capacity queries differ between SF and the host.
items.proposed: First-class hash-pinned external dependency snapshot and explicit scratch/cache capabilities, distinct from model inputs.
items.implemented_in_this_task: Private dependency manifests, copy/hash verification and isolated scratch directories; parent checks the full original package separately.

items.observed: A peer returned complete=true while retaining plausible/unverified candidates and SDK/project coverage limits. Parent acceptance required resolving and auditing those gaps.
items.proposed: Gate acceptance on unresolved candidates and essential coverage as well as process completion; preserve finding history and exactbase/head/tree.
items.implemented_in_this_task: Actual Claude follow-up and parent pair/tree/path audit. A second Codex agent is not labelled the opposite AI.

items.observed: Parent verifier argument, revision and working-directory mistakes required correction. Existing user changes included 39 translation entries and four other dirty files. These are not SF worker defects.
items.proposed: Construct commands from validated state, assert cwd/head, and use a reviewed application transaction with protected user-change overlays.
items.implemented_in_this_task: Guarded candidate application in a separate worktree; original changes backed up and compared by bytes/catalog entries. No reset or stash discarded them.

items.observed: SF runs remain verified_pending_review after separate parent acceptance and merge. A whole-repository public-history audit also takes many sequential GitHub calls without progress counters.
items.proposed: Link parent acceptance receipts and PR/squash IDs without changing SF verification meaning; provide audit progress counters and retain final manualpending state.

items.observed: Annual metadata and a fixed fixture did not prove all periods were fully observed. The repair pins independent counts, revision and range; unknown data is distinct from zero or unpublished data.
items.proposed: Make evidence-backed inputscope and unknown-state semantics explicit before UI date-range implementation.
items.implemented_in_this_task: SF repair 1cc579f8, parent whole-month/native/month-end checks and actual Claude follow-ups completed. PR #556 merged; the old annual-end prose was corrected.

items.observed: The 29,760 January API counts differed in nine month-end cells from January Parquet alone. February Parquet contains 30 January pickups, ten in the selected zones; including them resolves every cell.
items.proposed: Treat filenameperiod andeventtimeperiod separately; retainfailure andadjacentsourceprovenance.

items.observed: Overlapping actual/forecast chart marks lost explicit New York labels and quantiles in normal accessibility output. Isolated-series checks had passed.
items.proposed: For charts, test overlapping actual/forecast values and accessibility element boundaries as well as visual axes and isolated series.
items.implemented_in_this_task: The first Text-child repair failed per-interval correspondence. Explicit elements at 60109c0 passed 16 normal Mac interval labels with values/quantiles. Audio Graph and spoken VoiceOver were not measured.

items.proposed: Resume from process/lock/source/artifact receipts; do not restart or delete a shared job merely because the chat tool session disappeared. Freeze the artifact only after competing builds complete.
items.implemented_in_this_task: Inspected processes, owner/inode and artifact hashes, reused existing jobs and resumed the reviewer. Preserved the previous artifact identity rather than starting duplicate work.

items.proposed: Include production-created values at serialization boundaries; separate byte/hash stability from in-memory value equality and retain independent live integration.
items.implemented_in_this_task: Journal-specific reference-clock encoding/envelope 2, three fractional-date cases and two successful later native trials. The API canonical-byte format is unchanged.

items.implemented_in_this_task: Read-only diagnosis and one existing worker. No account secrets, inferred provider cause or SF product modifications are included.
